title: Mavlink_NoGPS reference behavior
current_gap: The sensor/positioning and control conditions of the no-GPS mode are undefined; the GNSS fault slice is an event seam, not this mode's configuration contract.

atoms.required: The GNSS signal-loss seam stays an event; the mode is a declared configuration with different identity

atoms.name: reference_behavior

scope_rule: a GNSS interruption event inside a GPS-capable configuration is not the no-GPS mode; mode legality is declared per control path
